title: Owner: complete Coconala SMS(電話番号)認証 on the owner account (required before any 公開依頼 application)
detail: Pressing 応募する on https://coconala.com/requests/5303405 redirects to https://coconala.com/mypage/sms?required_sms_auth=requests. Coconala requires phone SMS verification before applying to requests. This is identity verification, which PG-1 condition 7 excludes, so only the owner can do it (~2 min, owner's phone). Once done, mac-local sends the ready 5303405 draft (¥8,000/3d) under PG-1. 5303405 closes 2026-10-12.
acceptance: Owner confirms SMS auth done; 応募する opens the proposal form
